Consultant Catalyst Plans
For single Independent Consultants or Boutique Advisory Firms specializing in third-party risk management services.

For Start-Up TPRM Service Provider Organizations looking to gain insight, support, and promotion.

CERTIFICATIONS
CERTIFICATIONS
Get certified with TPRA to advance your career and enhance your professional knowledge.​
Learn More
THIRD PARTY CYBER RISK ASSESSOR (TPCRA)
CERTIFICATE PROGRAM
The TPCRA Certification is a specialized qualification that validates expertise in assessing third-party cybersecurity controls, managing cyber risk assessments, and evidencing proficiency in cybersecurity assessment techniques, as well as establishing credibility for third-party risk management professionals.​
The Third Party Risk Management (TPRM) Certificate Program, offered by TPRA in collaboration with our trusted partners, provides comprehensive training designed to enhance knowledge and expertise in TPRM best practices.​

2025 Virtual Conference
Continuous TPRM Program Improvement
Wednesday, September 10, 2025 • 9:00 AM - 4:00 PM Central
Open to All • Free • 6 CPE Credits Available
Registration Closed
Join the
Third Party Risk Association (TPRA)
for our 2025 Virtual Conference: "
Continuous TPRM Program Improvement
" on
Wednesday, September 10, 2025
, from
9:00 AM to 4:00 PM CT
.
​
Elevate Your TPRM Strategy
This full-day virtual event is designed for third-party risk management professionals seeking to enhance their programs through continuous improvement. Engage with industry experts, participate in interactive sessions, and gain actionable insights to refine your TPRM practices. This event will feature two speaking tracks and up to twelve sessions. Attendees can earn up to six CPE credits.
​
Key Details
Date:
Wednesday, September 10, 2025
Time:
9:00 AM - 4:00 PM Central
Location:
Zoom
Cost:
Free
Open to:
All TPRM Professionals
​
Who Should Attend?
This conference is ideal for:
TPRM professionals seeking to enhance their programs.
Risk management and compliance officers.
Procurement and vendor management specialists.
IT and cybersecurity professionals involved in third-party risk.
​
Registration
Don't miss this opportunity to drive continuous improvement in your TPRM program and stay ahead in the evolving risk landscape. Registration is open to all TPRM professionals.
Registration Closed
